about: Package 11 (the Concept notes and the engine log): every scenario this package makes runnable, each with what it exercises. 36-notes-logs.mjs holds on the concept page too (--page hotstep-tiers.html: all pass there but the one marked pending, the concept's F-18 for the notes); each is a concept scenario's checks of the notes or the log, with the steps that need another package's part (the prompt card, generation) left out, so every feature here is caught by a scenario that runs today. The concept's scenarios that open the notes or the log but also need such a part are listed as waiting on that package; `excluded` lists those that touch these overlays and are left out, each with the reason.

scenarios.why: The notes button opens the drawer over its scrim, a modal dialog named by its heading, at the window's right edge above the scrim and the scrim above the page; focus on its ×; Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside; Escape, Enter on the ×, the scrim and a click on × close it, focus back on the button (notes-open.ts, layers.ts).
It slides in and its scrim fades in on the concept's keyframes; closing hides both at once and leaves inert copies playing the exit, gone when it has played (overlay-exit.ts ovOut).
Under the notes Ctrl+Z takes nothing back and says to close them first, F9 opens no picker, Escape closes them (the notes as a modal layer).
The heading, the concept's five sections in order, each section's points, the words set in bold, the top bar's point naming the engine log (i18n/words/notes.ts, notes.tsx).
On a short window the notes scroll without a scroll bar, their edges fading where there is more; scrolled to the foot the × still stands at the top and takes the press (S-35).

The VRAM meter opens the log (aria-expanded, focus on Close), a region named Engine log along the window's foot rising from it; the page's room at its foot (--logs-h, html.logs-open, the body's padding) and the go bar and a toast standing on it (F-15); a press elsewhere leaves it; a second press, Close and Escape close it, focus back on the meter; Enter on the meter opens it.
The notes open over the log; Escape closes the notes, then the engine panel, then the log, focus left where it was; closing the log plays its exit.

What the log says on ACE-Step, MiniMax-Music3, HeartMuLa and Stable Audio 3: the engine and its models whole (F-34), the server's status, the models by role, the plugins, the VRAM as the meter's, the queue; a model chosen in the engine panel follows at once (derive/logs.ts engineLogModel, services/logs.ts).
At 390 the log takes at most a third of the screen with its head on one row (S-23), and the notes take the whole width.
Pending (F-18) in the concept, right here: a toast raised while the notes are open joins their Tab cycle, and Tab goes on round to the notes (layers.ts).
Pending (F-08) in the concept, right here: Alt+3 under the Concept notes leaves the tier (modal-keys.ts).

The notes (Shift+Tab wraps, Escape, the scrim, ×) and the engine log (the meter opens and toggles it with what it says, a click outside leaves it with the go bar standing on it, Close, Escape), then Escape closing the engine panel's list and the panel, and the save row.
Ctrl+Z under the presets popover and under the Concept notes changes nothing.

excluded.why: F-18 for the picker, package 8's (acceptance/8-overlays.json); for the notes it is 36-notes-logs/a-toast-joins-the-notes-tab-cycle.
The VRAM meter's tip ("Click for the engine log."): the tooltips' package (8).
The keyboard tip on the VRAM meter: the tooltips' package (8).
The notes button's 40px is the slice's top bar (package 8's acceptance).
